name: Peggy Nille · Hidden Worlds in Bloom

features.label: Large shapes first
features.explanation: First simplify existing forms into large silhouettes, then arrange small patterns in layers
features.evidence: Canopies are simplified into rounded masses, ovals, spires or fans; bird wings, flowers and roofs all have readable silhouettes. Fine patterns fill these large shapes, establishing three scales—large forms, pattern clusters and tiny dots and lines—so the details do not all compete for attention.
features.zh: 先概括原有形体的大剪影，再分层安排小纹样
features.en: First simplify existing forms into large silhouettes, then arrange small patterns in layers

features.label: Fine lines explain structure
features.explanation: Describe structure through fine internal lines and color differences at edges
features.evidence: Dots, short leaf shapes, fine veins, parallel arcs, feather-like hatching, fish-scale grids and irregular rings recur. A given pattern follows the direction of branches, leaves or feathers, while different species and forms use different rhythms. Repetition varies in size and spacing.
features.zh: 用内部细线和边缘色差说明结构
features.en: Describe structure through fine internal lines and color differences at edges

features.label: Bright colors on a dark ground
features.explanation: Set concentrated, repeated bright local colors against stable dark fields
features.evidence: Near-black, deep blue, green or white first establishes the broad ground; red-orange, yellow-green, pink-violet and cyan-blue then create local contrasts. Highly saturated colors are concentrated and repeated. Dark shapes and relatively quiet areas stabilize the image; not every inch is equally bright.
features.zh: 用稳定深色承托有集中与重复的鲜明局部色
features.en: Set concentrated, repeated bright local colors against stable dark fields

features.label: Reduced volume
features.explanation: Reduce volumetric shading so local color and pattern describe forms
features.evidence: Clear local color areas and differences between adjacent colors separate forms, while volumetric shading is reduced; fine lines and internal patterns explain structure. Some edges and color areas show slight hand-drawn irregularities. Dots are coarser in attached image 1, while lines are cleaner in image 4. These observations describe visible texture only; appearance does not establish gouache, screenprinting, collage or digital software as the medium or method.
features.zh: 弱化体积明暗，让局部色与纹样承担形体信息
features.en: Reduce volumetric shading so local color and pattern describe forms

features.label: Layers through overlap
features.explanation: Keep object relationships and build layers through overlap and size differences
features.evidence: Depth comes mainly from overlapping forms, changes of scale, vertical trunks and local gaps; the decorative flatness remains strong. Large foreground leaves surround middle-ground trees, while houses, figures and animals interweave at different depths. Spatial logic serves the image’s readability.
features.zh: 保留原有物件关系，用重叠与大小差异建立层次
features.en: Keep object relationships and build layers through overlap and size differences

features.label: Scales of pattern
features.explanation: Within existing forms, organize three scales: large shapes, pattern clusters, and small dots and lines
features.evidence: Dots, short leaf shapes, fine veins, parallel arcs, feather-like hatching, fish-scale grids and irregular rings recur. A given pattern follows the direction of branches, leaves or feathers, while different species and forms use different rhythms. Repetition varies in size and spacing.
features.zh: 在现有形体内组织大形、纹样簇和小点线三个尺度
features.en: Within existing forms, organize three scales: large shapes, pattern clusters, and small dots and lines

features.label: The pleasure of discovery
features.explanation: Create a rich imaginative narrative atmosphere that rewards close looking
features.evidence: Small figures, animals and windowed houses resemble story clues hidden within patterns, often with fantastical size relationships. Viewing shifts from broad color areas at a distance to details up close. In image 2, the figure and two radiating white flower forms establish a local action relationship; in image 3, strings of lanterns create an upward rhythm.
features.zh: 营造丰富、幻想、值得细看的叙事趣味
features.en: Create a rich imaginative narrative atmosphere that rewards close looking

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
